spec.description: spec defines the desired state of EIPGateway

egressType.description: egressType specifies the overlay egress method. Supported values: Host, Gateway. Defaults to Host. Currently only Host is supported.

gatewayConfig.description:
gatewayConfig is required when egressType is "Gateway".
NOTE: This is not currently implemented.

network.description: network defines the network used for interconnection with the switch.

localIP.description: localIP is the OVN-side interconnection address (e.g. "100.64.0.1/30").

vlanNetwork.description: vlanNetwork is the VLAN network used for interconnection with the switch.

nodes.description:
nodes lists the gateway nodes in active-backup mode.
Key is the node name, value is the priority (higher value means higher priority).

routes.description: routes lists the static routes for the gateway.

items.description: RouteEntry defines a single route in the route table.

cidr.description: cidr is the target/source CIDR depending on the policy.

enableECMP.description: enableECMP indicates whether this route uses equal-cost multi-path routing.

nextHopIP.description:
nextHopIP is the next hop IP address. If the VPC/EIPGateway's logical router
does not have a corresponding direct route, this route will not be applied.
"discard" represents a blackhole route.

policy.description:
policy specifies the route policy: SrcIP or DstIP.
Defaults to DstIP.

hostConfig.description: hostConfig is required when egressType is "Host".

localIP.description: localIP is the lrp ip address of service subnet.

scope.description:
scope indicates the EIP network type. Supported values: Intranet, Public.
Defaults to Public. Currently only Public is supported. Immutable after creation.

status.description: status defines the observed state of EIPGateway

boundResources.description: boundResources holds OVN-related resource IDs for the EIPGateway.

Each condition has a unique type and reflects the status of a specific aspect of the resource.

- "Valid": the spec parameters are valid
- "Applied": the resource has been applied and its status is synced with the latest spec
- "Ready": the EIPGateway is ready for use

The status of each condition is one of True, False, or Unknown.

lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description:

For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
